description:
## Goal

Replace `DispatchDemand::Whole` with one typed semantic-question domain that records only what a dispatch or returned-value observation can distinguish. Local and acyclic pullback through `InputFlowRelation` stays exact. Recursive structural pullback uses one explicit source-derived finite observation partition, so recursion terminates without turning an atom, numeric, map, bitstring, tuple, list, or guard question into authority over unrelated type axes.

An unchanged relation/question reproduces the same retained `InputDemand` value and generation. The implementation must reduce needless activation distinctions and work, not merely rename the old top value.

## Signal

`Whole` currently means “retain the complete `Ty`” for literal, type, map, bitstring, and guard questions. After transitive forwarding, 344 rows across 174 functions gained a forwarding-introduced `Whole` without a behavior mover. Those rows are the breadth signal: an atom literal question, for example, keeps adjacent list, tuple, callable, numeric, map, and bitstring alternatives that the question cannot inspect.

The temporary recursive signal is `.214`'s structural cost/depth frontier. It terminates, but its bound is derived from traversal cost rather than meaning and it widens a deep non-bottom subtree to `Whole`.

Corpus activation counts, semantic evaluations, generations, allocations, and emitted artifacts are the authority. Wall-clock and CI duration only corroborate them.

## Why unrestricted recursive exactness is not the contract

Finite primitive axes do not imply a finite-height domain of located questions. Actual first-order fz can express:

```
left({a, _}) = a
right({_, b}) = b
f(0, x) = x
f(n, x) = right(f(n - 1, left(x)))
```

At the retained-relation level, use the smaller isolated form:

```
input[0].field(2)         -> return
input[0].field(0)         -> self-call input[0]
self-call result.field(1) -> return
```

For a result question `q`, the exact equation is `T(q) = field(2).q ∪ field(0).T(field(1).q)`, whose concrete paths are `{ 0^n 2 1^n q | n >= 0 }`. Every finite unfolding adds a distinct location. For every `n`, two finite `Ty` values can differ only at that path, so “current values are finite” does not give the reusable demand fact a finite quotient.

This is the repository's instance of the known boundary in Thomas Reps, “Undecidability of Context-Sensitive Data-Dependence Analysis,” ACM TOPLAS 22(1), 2000, DOI 10.1145/345099.345137 (https://research.cs.wisc.edu/wpis/papers/toplas00.pdf): exact call/return matching corresponds to `CallSiteId`-correlated `DirectCallFlow`/`CallResult` routing, while constructor/selector matching corresponds to `InputPathStep` projection/reconstruction and prefix cancellation. Combining both exactly is undecidable in general even for first-order functional programs.

We do not restrict the language to avoid this ordinary recursive direct-call shape. We instead state the finite abstraction and its loss explicitly. No test or documentation may claim unrestricted recursive path exactness.

## Ordering and ownership

`fz-kdt.214` first publishes the one exact normalized typed path relation. This ticket defines the final question atoms, exact nonrecursive pullback, and recursive observation abstraction. `fz-kdt.213` then replaces the private cone calculation with ordinary reactive per-function formulas over this final domain. `fz-kdt.165` separately adds callable identity as a fourth atomic `InputDemand` dimension.

Adjacent tickets remain separate:

- `fz-kdt.124` refuted key-level empty-rung absorption.
- `fz-kdt.140` owns unused tuple-position specialization.
- `fz-kdt.146` owns exact-empty list predicate projection.
- `fz-kdt.165`/`.173` own callable-identity boundaries.
- `fz-kdt.181`/`.216` own partial spec refinement.
- `fz-kdt.202` owns malformed tuple predicate projection.
- `fz-kdt.209` owns rendered-string test assertions.

One World `InputFlowRelation` authority and one World `InputDemand` authority remain. There is no second path walker, mask, fact, renderer classifier, or compatibility representation.

## Correct domain

### Typed question atoms

A demand is an immutable join of typed semantic question atoms. The vocabulary distinguishes at least:

- literal equality by runtime family and normalized literal denotation;
- numeric kind/value and numeric guard operations only to the precision the `Ty` lattice can represent;
- type-membership axes from the semantic type, not its display or raw interner order;
- tuple arity and selected tuple fields;
- list empty/cons shape, head, and tail;
- map kind, known typed-key presence, dynamic/except-key presence, selected value, and deciding-key identity;
- bitstring kind/shape separately from projected field/content;
- truthiness, equality, ordering, and the exact operand axes each guard operator reads;
- returned-value denotation as the explicit join of its semantic axes, not a verbatim-`Ty` escape variant.

Boolean and `nil` literals normalize to their atom denotations; raw and UTF-8-branded binary keys normalize to the same runtime key; floats remain bit-exact. Callable identity is not smuggled into this ticket.

Map presence terminates at the parent map. Presence of `k` in reconstructed `%{k => x}` does not make `x` authoritative; a selected-value question does. `InputPullback::WholeOrigin` becomes an explicit deciding-origin/key-identity question independent of the selected result's subtree.

### Exact local and acyclic location transfer

Every `InputPathStep` has one typed pullback rule. Source/destination residual composition continues to use the `InputFlowRelation` path algebra. Direct, projected, reconstructed, delivered, protocol, map, list, tuple, and bitstring routes preserve the question atom and exact location. Equal callee questions may share computation, but two callsites never cross-connect.

### Recursive observation partition

For each recursive component, derive a finite observation partition `M` solely from its retained relation and local question paths:

- exact cells name every typed path/residual position that occurs in the component's `InputFlow` edges or local dispatch questions;
- typed descendant cells represent continuations below each named position after recursive repetition;
- typed other cells represent same-kind selectors/keys/fields not named by an exact cell, so an unmentioned sibling is not conflated with a named one;
- question atoms remain a separate finite vocabulary `A`; location abstraction never promotes one atom to a broader semantic axis.

Transfers inside the component are the best sound transfer expressible in the declared domain: `alpha(transfer(gamma(cell)))`. This preserves every concrete exact flow and adds only location uncertainty forced by `M`. Callsite routing remains exact; only recursive structural observations are abstracted.

The demand lattice is the powerset of `M x A`. Its height is at most `|M| * |A| + 1`, a semantic bound determined by the finite current source relation and question vocabulary, not recursion depth, SCC size, traversal count, type-arena allocation, or source order. Source replacement derives a replacement partition/value from the replacement relation.

For the `0^n 2 1^n` witness, every concrete matched path must be included. The finite abstraction may include mismatched recursive depths when the partition cannot express their correlation, but it must retain the original typed question, the named field-2 observation, and the typed recursive descendant cells. It must not widen to `Whole`, admit an unmentioned sibling such as field 3 through a named exact cell, or acquire an unrelated question axis. No claim of a globally least regular-language over-approximation is made; “best” is relative to the explicitly constructed finite partition.

## Retained domain, atomic solver, and activation identity

`InputDemand` retains one immutable, shared `QuestionDomain` together with compact demand bitsets. The domain owns the normalized typed atom vocabulary and canonical location languages; singleton languages are exact paths and recursive languages are canonical finite automata. Cell ids never outlive or become meaningful apart from their retained domain. Equal reproduction compares canonical domain content and bitsets, with pointer identity only as a fast path, so unchanged facts retain their allocation and generation without copying DFA tables into every question.

Each recursive component uses one total symbolic DFA. Its exact states are the finite prefix trie of every local-question, origin, sink, binding, residual, and exact boundary path. Named-overflow states continue to distinguish source-named selector classes indefinitely; encountering an unmentioned selector enters a typed-other escape state. Cells are disjoint and cover every path. Dynamic and except map selectors compile to unions of disjoint typed selector classes, and map remainder continues to use the one `compose_paths` residual algebra. Best sound transfer is the finite product-automaton relation `alpha(T(gamma(cell)))`; no cell is rewritten or reinterpreted under another component.

Demand evaluation is atomic because every transfer is union-distributive. Dispatch is its constant local seed plus the union of atomic downstream answers. The solver memoizes `(mode, function, location-cell, semantic-question)` observations and uses a delta worklist over first-time bit insertions; it never keys work by an arbitrary powerset demand. Bounds and telemetry include functions, input/return/callsite ports, cells, atoms, inserted bits, and rule firings. `|M| * |A| + 1` is only the height of one demand component, never a claim about the whole solver.

An activation key denotes one canonical joint observation class, not an input arrow plus a second discriminator. A deterministic schema may be derived from that class for ABI purposes, but it is a cache of the one identity and never analysis evidence or an independently compared field. `ActivationInputs` remains the sole authority for exact input rows used by semantic analysis, transport, and code generation. Consumers that reconstruct evidence through `ActivationKey::inputs` move to that retained fact. Latent activation discovery must publish the exact inputs already owned by its callable/demand source; `SeedActivation` may not manufacture them from a quotient key, and no key-to-row side table is introduced.

`TypeMember` identity is the normalized executable membership question, or an owner-interned typed question id derived from it, rather than raw `Ty` equality/order. Located tuple/list/map/bitstring derivatives and relational/returned questions live in the joint observation domain even where `Ty` cannot encode them. The root unary `Ty` cell-saturation law remains useful as a sound schema projection, but it is not the identity and has no fallback that preserves an unrelated whole input.

## Strategy

1. Pin the contradiction and the chosen abstraction with the isolated relation law before changing production code.
2. Introduce one normalized typed question value and prove join commutative, associative, idempotent, finite-height, and independent of display/interner ordering.
3. Map every production `Region` and guard expression to its exact question atoms. Nested guard dispatch substitutes its inputs instead of treating nested ordinals as outer inputs.
4. Pull those atoms through the existing path algebra. Keep map presence, map value, map key identity, and bitstring shape/content facets distinct.
5. Derive `M` from recursive relation facts and solve over `M x A`; prove the bound and schedule independence.
6. Replace the arrow-only activation identity with one canonical joint observation identity derived from the retained question domain. `ActivationInputs` remains the sole exact type/evidence authority; no ordinary `Ty` is overloaded as a question answer and no independent arrow/schema field competes in key equality. Typed comparisons may be memoized in World by operation and immutable operands; display strings and raw interner order are never authority.
7. Delete the old `Whole` and structural-cost normalizer only after the new finite-domain laws are green.
8. Measure the 344-row population and named causal corpus movements. Accept reductions; explain any increase by a semantic distinction already required here or leave the ticket open.

## TDD

- RED: the isolated recursive relation above cannot be represented exactly by the old finite tree without cost/depth widening. The new domain includes every `0^n 2 1^n` flow through its recursive cells, converges independent of order, retains the seed question, excludes field 3 from the named field-2 cell, and does not acquire a sibling atom/numeric/map/bitstring axis.
- Atom literal dispatch retains the atom discriminant while collapsing adjacent list, tuple, callable, numeric, map, and bitstring alternatives.
- Numeric literal/type/guard questions retain exactly the numeric distinctions they read and no nonnumeric axes.
- Tuple and list shape/field questions pull backward through direct, projected, reconstructed, Head, and Tail routes without retaining unrelated siblings.
- Known map-key presence does not demand the field value; known field-value questions do. Reconstructed maps and dynamic/except selectors obey the facet rules.
- Bitstring kind/shape questions do not retain unrelated content; binding-dependent sizes demand their actual size subjects.
- Transitive acyclic forwarding produces the same exact axis/location question at every caller.
- Two same-callee callsites remain isolated.
- Self and mutual recursion converge under FIFO/LIFO/permuted schedules within the `M x A` bound.
- Equal demand reproduction retains allocation and generation and wakes nobody.
- The recorded 344 over-broad forwarded rows fall or are causally accounted for; existing bought distinctions, exact may-flow, semantic answers, and artifacts remain.

A high-amplification behavior fixture belongs here only if it uniquely proves question-axis collapse. It must not duplicate `.140`'s unused tuple-position exponential, `.146`'s list-predicate projection, or `.182`'s empty-list denotational identity coverage.

## Required deletion

Delete:

- `DispatchDemand::Whole`, the arrow-only `Types::convergence_collapse` key authority, and every verbatim-`Ty` fallback;
- every fallback that silently widens an expressible typed question to all axes;
- stale “whole value” claims;
- `.214`'s `DemandRecursionPlan`, structural cost/depth budget, `normalize_demand`/`N_K` policy, and tests that bless cost-derived recursive over-approximation.

Those deletions occur only once the source-derived partition, best sound transfer, and `M x A` height proof are implemented and green. Temporary probes or migration scaffolding are removed in this ticket. The finite observation partition is the principled recursive abstract domain, not temporary scaffolding and not a parallel authority.

## Acceptance

- Every production dispatch predicate and guard operator maps exhaustively to typed question atoms.
- `InputDemand` retains one canonical shared question domain; activation identity is one joint observation class, while `ActivationInputs` alone owns exact input evidence and latent discovery publishes its real row.
- Every `InputFlow` selector and pullback kind has one tested transfer rule.
- Local and acyclic composition is exact; recursive abstraction is sound, finite, source-derived, and explicit about its location-only loss.
- The `0^n 2 1^n` witness and negative sibling/axis controls pass without `Whole` or a cost/depth frontier.
- No relevant semantic distinction is lost; no orthogonal `Ty` axis is retained merely because the domain could not name the question.
- Equal facts retain allocation/generation and wake nobody.
- Causal activation/work movement is no worse without a named semantic reason; the 344-row signal falls or is fully attributed.
- Focused domain, pullback, keying, map, guard, bitstring, and recursion laws pass.
- Full serial library, serial fixture matrix, all three target doors, cross-process determinism, documentation checks, `cargo check`, strict clippy, formatting, and diff checks pass.
- A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review accepts the final frozen diff before its one commit and close.

The one divergent shape found (self-nesting accumulator) hangs at base with no forwarding at all -- fz-kdt.177's class, not this.

title: Make InputDemand express exact semantic question axes
